title: calc_sc_gsea_score: Calculates scores for pre-ranked GSEA — calc_sc_gsea_score
text: scoring metric uses Seurat FindMarkers output table incorporates p-value fold change determine magnitude, using percent expression values weighting factors.  basic formula : -log_10(p-value) * sign (log2FC) * max(pct.1, pct.2) + log2FC p-value recorded zero (.e. machine error), formula adjusted 500 * sign(log2FC) * max(pct.1, pct.2) + log2FC formula preserve ranking indicated magnitude fold change,also diminishing significance lowly-expressed genes.
